# True Blue Roof Restorations & Repairs

## Services

- [Roof Restoration](https://trueblueroofrandr.com.au/roof-restoration/): A full restoration puts an old tile roof back in working order, not just back in colour. We fix what keeps the water out first — tiles and ridge — and coat it last.
- [Ridge Cap Re-bedding & Re-pointing](https://trueblueroofrandr.com.au/roof-repointing/): A rotten ridge bed is the most common failure on an old tile roof, and it's invisible from the ground. It lets water straight into the roof space.
- [Roof Tile Replacement](https://trueblueroofrandr.com.au/roof-tile-replacement/): Cracked, broken or slipped tiles let water past the overlap that keeps your roof dry. We replace them properly — not with a smear of silicone.
- [Roof Pressure Cleaning](https://trueblueroofrandr.com.au/roof-cleaning/): Moss and lichen hold water against the tile and creep up under the laps. A proper clean gets rid of them and shows what the roof really looks like underneath.
- [Roof Painting & Sealing](https://trueblueroofrandr.com.au/roof-painting/): A good-looking roof that still leaks isn't a good roof. We only coat once the tiles and ridge underneath are right — then primer and two coats of membrane.
- [Roof Leak Detection & Repair](https://trueblueroofrandr.com.au/roof-leak-repair/): Where the stain is on your ceiling is rarely where the water gets in. We trace the leak to its source and fix that, not the symptom.
